unit_attributes.statement: A determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary.

The Secretary must, upon request, review a determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity, and the review must be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination.

If the Secretary's review is not completed within 90 days after receiving from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding, the determination of the State shall become final at the end of the 90th day.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the review is not completed within 90 days
